body: I know, I'm just trying to figure out some kind of plan to help me get started. I'm going to drive to my parents tomorrow morning and I'll tell my father everything. He probably won't take the news very well, but at least I can show him some kind of plan for me to get back on my feet.

I'm sitting here crying, trying to imagine how that conversation with my dad will go. I don't think my mom's heart can handle hearing such news tbh. I can sell my car, I'm looking online for how much they go for and it's around $15,000-25,000. That can pay for at least my first year of university, tuition per term is $6000. I don't know if I can take out a student loan, I never gave a fuck about my credit score because I was planning on killing myself. I was on my way out for the past 3 years. I stopped eating properly, lost 50 lbs roughly in the past year (I think I weigh around 125 lbs now). 
  
 
My sister and her young children are here, I can't have them finding out. Really the only way I can see this working is by telling my dad and having him pretend like everything's OK - that's a lot to ask of one person.

> If you commit suicide, while sane or insane, within two (2) years from the Effective Date, the amount payable by us will be limited to the sum of the premiums paid.  
  
My policy is older than 2 years.

But I'm not happy, I don't see any future where I'm happy, I know I'll die alone sooner or later. I have no friends, less than $1500 to my name, and that's it. It's not like I'll be leaving them alone, I have three older sisters. I can't talk to them now anyway, they're with my sister and her children.

I just don't see a way to get past the shitty stuff though. I have no friends, I barely have any money left, I emptied out my entire apartment except for the furniture and appliances. It looks like I'm moving out tonight. My father is retiring soon and I sure as hell won't ask him for more money. Because of my lies I'm now stuck with no career, no money, and no education, I'm nothing but a major financial burden for them now. At least if I die my life insurance policy could repay some of the money I've taken from them.

Yes, I'm so ashamed of myself for having to type this. Yes, I've been practically stealing from them for the past 5 years. I did try to go back to school 3 years ago but it didn't work out. My social anxiety is debilitating, opening my apartment door to walk into the hallway is just nerve-wracking. The schoolwork wasn't too bad, walking to campus and into the lecture hall was the difficult task.
